title: Fairness via Explanation Quality: Evaluating Disparities in the Quality of Post hoc Explanations
reasoning: The paper's central theme is fairness, a core ethical principle in AI. It proposes and implements an evaluation framework specifically designed to measure disparities (a form of unfairness) in the quality of AI explanations across different demographic groups. The research is explicitly situated in the context of AI ethics, as indicated by its publication in the 'AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES'22)'. The entire investigation is driven by the ethical consequences of inequitable explanation quality in high-stakes decisions.
